_doc: Which tcgcsv groups are processed, which era each belongs to, and which groups are subsets whose cards come out of a parent set's packs. Rules run in order: deny -> subset -> explicit -> eraRules. A group in the date window that matches nothing is reported under build-report.unrecognizedGroups (add it to `deny` or `explicit`).

explicit._doc: groupId -> era for special sets whose names carry no era prefix.

subsets._doc: Explicit child groupId -> parent groupId. Children are also auto-detected with subsetPattern; explicit entries win.
